item.title: The Highway & Coastal Masterclass Loop: The Perfect 200KM Ride for New Motorcyclists
item.description: Taking a new rider out on the open road for the first time is a massive milestone. You want to get them out of the city traffic, but you don’t want to throw them straight into the deep end of the Karak twisties or the heavy gridlock of the main expressways. They need a route that builds saddle confidence, gets them used to highway wind buffeting, and introduces them to mild cornering—all in one manageable morning.
